from eg_contract_balance ecb where ecb.period_code = #{periodCode} and ecb.del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from (select max(tmp.id) id, tmp.client_code ,tmp.contract_code ,tmp.business_code from (select * from eg_contract_balance order by client_code ,contract_code ,business_code) tmp where tmp.period_code = #{periodCode} and tmp.del_flag = '0' group by tmp.client_code ,tmp.contract_code ,tmp.business_code) ecb_max where ecb.id = ecb_max.id)
